hooks.name: agent-comment-lint
hooks.command: $guard = $GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR + '\.gemini\agent-comment-lint-guard.cmd'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $guard)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Blocked: agent-comment-lint guard is missing.'); exit 2 }; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1; & $guard gemini; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }; exit 0
